RAKAZO_NAV_LINKS also rejects links to the app's own routes written in other letter cases or percent-encoded, such as /API/me , matching how the bundled proxy routes them. Password managers no longer fill or save in the vault's login fields. identidad.text: Mercury is an open-source agent with a personality you write yourself, a memory that stays on your disk, and a permission system that sits between the model and your machine.

computadora.text: It reads and writes your files, runs commands, ships code through git and GitHub, researches the web and keeps a schedule.

memoria.text: Second Brain: typed, deduplicated facts in SQLite with full-text search, all on your disk.

rutinas.text: Scheduled automations - Mercury Bots run on schedules, hand work to each other, and deliver finished files.

apps.text: It runs on your machine, asks before it acts, and works with any model, from Mercury Desktop, your terminal, browser, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or Signal.
It answers from what it remembers about you, works with ~50 built-in tools, and follows you from the terminal to Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal, or the web.
You choose per session whether Mercury asks every time or runs freely, and members of a shared Telegram or Discord channel cannot widen their own access.
